facts.text: El Salvador has a Pacific coastline.
Guatemala and Honduras are its land neighbors.

culture.text: Nawat, also called Pipil, is an Indigenous language associated with western El Salvador.

food.name: Pupusas
food.text: These thick corn tortillas contain fillings such as cheese or pork.
